description: This file defines the `Gmac` class in the `Awsypto	olyfill` namespace. It implements cryptographic operations related to GMAC (Galois Message Authentication Code), including encryption, buffer management, and cryptographic math operations such as block multiplication in GF(2^128). The class interacts with external cryptographic functions (`openssl_encrypt`) and uses custom ByteArray and Key classes. It is part of the AWS SDK for PHP, specifically for cryptographic polyfills.

classes.name: Gmac
classes.description: Implements cryptographic GMAC functionality for the AWS SDK, including encryption, buffer management, and cryptographic computations in GF(2^128). Uses external OpenSSL functions and custom ByteArray/Key classes.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructs a Gmac object, initializes buffers and cryptographic parameters based on the provided key, nonce, and key size.

methods.name: update
methods.description: Updates the Gmac state with additional data blocks, managing internal buffers and performing block multiplication operations.

methods.name: finish
methods.description: Completes the GMAC process, producing the authentication tag based on accumulated data and associated lengths.

methods.name: bit
methods.description: Retrieves a specific bit from a ByteArray at the specified index.

methods.name: blockMultiply
methods.description: Performs Galois field multiplication of two 16-byte ByteArrays, a critical cryptographic operation.

methods.name: flush
methods.description: Processes any remaining bytes in the internal buffer to update the internal state.
